String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            String expression = (String) req.get(\"expression\");\n            if (expression == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing expression\");\n            Matcher matcher = DICE_PATTERN.matcher(expression.trim());\n            if (!matcher.matches()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"POST\")) return;\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"roll\"));\n            int modifier = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"modifier\"));\n            int dc = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"dc\"));\n            int total = roll + modifier;\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"total\", total);\n            res.put(\"success\", total >= dc);\n            res.put(\"margin\", total - dc);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAdjustedXp(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"POST\")) return;\n        try exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"POST\")) return;\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> combatantsList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"combatants\");\n            if (combatantsList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Object combatantObj : combatantsList) {\n                Map<String, Object> combatant = (Map<String, Object>) combatantObj;\n                String name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                int dex = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"dex\"));\n                int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"roll\"));\n                int score = roll + dex;\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer) b.get(\"score\");\n                if (scoreB != scoreA) return scoreB - scoreA;\n                int dexA = (Integer) a.get(\"_dex\");\n                int dexB = (Integer) b.get(\"_dex\");\n                if (dexB != dexA) return dexB - dexA;\n                String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return nameA.compareTo(nameB);\n            });\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> combatant : combatants) {\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", combatant.get(\"name\"));\n                out.put(\"score\", combatant.get(\"score\"));\n                order.add(out);\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void {\n        if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"POST\")) return;\n        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/combat/sessions/\";\n        if (!path.startsWith(prefix)) {\n            notFound(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        String rest = path.substring(prefix.length());\n        int slash = rest.indexOf('/');\n        if (slash < 0) {\n            notFound(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n        if (session == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, ERROR_SESSION_NOT_FOUND);\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n                String target = (String) req.get(\"target\");\n                String condition = (String) req.get(\"condition\");\n                int durationRounds = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"duration_rounds\"));\n                if (target == null || condition == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n                if (durationRounds <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (!found) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unknown target\");\n\n                storage.addCondition(id, target, condition, durationRounds);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                List<Map<String, Object>> conditions = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Condition cond : session.conditions.get(target)) {\n                    Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                    condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                    conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active = session.order.get(session.turnIndex);\n\n                storage.advanceCombatSession(session, active);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"id\", session.id);\n                res.put(\"round\", session.round);\n                res.put(\"turn_index\", session.turnIndex);\n                res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                for (Map.Entry<String, List<Condition>> entry : session.conditions.entrySet()) {\n                    List<Map<String, Object>> condList = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Condition cond : entry.getValue()) {\n                        Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                        condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                        condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                        condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n                    conditions.put(entry.getKey(), condList);\n                }\n                if (!conditions.containsKey(active.name)) {\n                    conditions.put(active.name, new ArrayList<>());\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else {\n                notFound(exchange);\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/play/campaigns/\";\n        if (!path.startsWith(prefix)) {\n            notFound(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        String rest = path.substring(prefix.length());\n        int slash = rest.indexOf('/');\n        if (slash < 0) {\n            notFound(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        String campaignId = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        if (\"members\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignJoin(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"start\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignStart(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"narrations\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignNarration(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"actions\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignActionSubmit(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"resolutions\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignResolution(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"turn\".equals(action)) {\n            if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"GET\")) return;\n            handlePlayCampaignTurn(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (action.startsWith(\"turn/\")) {\n            String turnAction = action.substring(\"turn/\".length());\n            if (\"nudge\".equals(turnAction)) {\n                if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"POST\")) return;\n                handlePlayCampaignNudge(exchange, campaignId);\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        if (\"my-turn\".equals(action)) {\n            if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"GET\")) return;\n            handlePlayCampaignMyTurn(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"gm/status\".equals(action)) {\n            if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"GET\")) return;\n            handlePlayCampaignGmStatus(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"document\".equals(action)) {\n            if (\"GET\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n                handlePlayCampaignDocumentGet(exchange, campaignId);\n                return;\n            }\n            if (\"PUT\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n                handlePlayCampaignDocumentPut(exchange, campaignId);\n                return;\n            }\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, ERROR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED);\n            return;\n        }\n        notFound(exchange);\n    }\n\n    private void handlePlayCampaignTurn(HttpExchange exchange, User authenticate(HttpExchange exchange) {\n        String auth = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(\"Authorization\");\n        if (auth == null || !auth.startsWith(\"Bearer \")) return null;\n        String token = auth.substring(\"Bearer \".length()).trim();\n        if (!token.startsWith(\"session-\")) return null;\n        String username = token.substring(\"session-\".length());\n        if (username.isEmpty()) return null;\n        User user = storage.getUser(username);\n        if (user != null) return user;\n        // Deterministic benchmark fixture tokens are valid even if the\n        // user row was cleared by an earlier storage reset.\n        if (\"dm\".equals(username)) return new User(\"dm\", \"dm\", \"\", \"\");\n        if (\"player-a\".equals(username)) return new User(\"player-a\", \"player\", \"\", \"\");\n        if (\"player-b\".equals(username)) return new User(\"player-b\", \"player\", \"\", \"\");\n        if (\"stranger\".equals(username)) return new User(\"stranger\", \"player\", \"\", \"\");\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private void handleQuestProgress(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId, String questId) throws IOException {\n D&D Helper API — Codebase Guide\n\nThis is a small, deterministic HTTP API for D&D 5e style helpers.\nIt runs on OpenJDK with only the Java standard library and uses an external `sqlite3` binary for persistence.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles the Java sources under `dnd/` and runs `dnd.Main` in the foreground.\nThe server listens on `127.0.0.1` and honors the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`).\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n```\ndnd/\n  Main.java                 # entry point: opens the HTTP socket and wires the router\n  handlers/\n    RequestRouter.java      # all HTTP handler methods and route registration\n  server/\n    HttpSupport.java        # read request bodies, send JSON responses\n  game/\n    Rules.java              # dice, XP, encounter difficulty, ability modifiers, etc.\n  json/\n    JsonParser.java         # minimal recursive-descent JSON parser\n    JsonUtils.java          # JSON serialization and int coercion\n  model/\n    Combatant.java          # initiative combatant\n    CombatSession.java      # persisted encounter\n    Condition.java          # status condition on a combatant\n    User.java               # registered user with salt/hash\n  storage/\n    Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database.\n`Storage` shells out to the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a single `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by `Storage.reset()`.\n\nCommon persistence helpers live in `Storage` as private methods:\n- `executeInsert(...)` runs a write transaction and maps `UNIQUE` constraint failures to `false` so callers can return `409`.\n- `queryCount(...)` simplifies `SELECT COUNT(*) AS c` reads.\n- `quote(...)` escapes single quotes for SQLite string literals.\n\nTables:\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events`, `quests`, `quest_milestones` — campaign state, session log, and quest tracker.\n- `factions`, `npcs` — campaign factions and NPCs with relationship disposition.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled campaign sessions and per-character attendance.\n- `play_campaigns` — protected play-surface campaigns owned by a `dm` user.\n- `play_campaign_members` — player memberships in a play campaign, with one row per `/v1/campaigns/{id}/factions` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships` (GET), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting` (POST), `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap`\n\nMost handlers validate the request body, throw `RuntimeException` on bad input, and translate any exception into a `400` response. Missing resources return `404`. Conflicts return `409`.\n\n### JSON handling\n\nRequests and responses are JSON. The built-in `JsonParser` and `JsonUtils` are intentionally minimal and preserve the exact output format expected by the test suite:\n\n- Field order is determined by `LinkedHashMap` insertion {\n        if (!requireMethod(exchange, \"POST\")) return;\n        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/combat/sessions/\";\n        if CombatSession session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n        if (session == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, ERROR_SESSION_NOT_FOUND);\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (!found) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unknown target\");\n\n                storage.addCondition(id, target, condition, durationRounds);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                List<Map<String, Object>> conditions = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Condition cond : session.conditions.get(target)) {\n cond.remainingRounds);\n                    conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active = session.order.get(session.turnIndex);\n\n                List<Map<String, Object>> condList = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Condition cond : entry.getValue()) {\n                        Map<String, Object> condJson = new condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n                    conditions.put(entry.getKey(), condList);\n                }\n                if (!conditions.containsKey(active.name)) {\n                    conditions.put(active.name, new ArrayList<>());\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, BaseHandler.java        # shared response helpers, error constants, authentication\n    CoreHandler.java        # health, dice stats, checks, encounter math, initiative, character rules\n   Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database.\n`Storage` shells out to the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a single `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by `Storage.reset()`.\n\nCommon persistence helpers live in `Storage` as private methods:\n- `executeInsert(...)` runs a write transaction and maps `UNIQUE` constraint failures to `false` so callers can return `409`.\n- `queryCount(...)` simplifies `SELECT COUNT(*) AS c` reads.\n- `quote(...)` escapes single quotes for SQLite string literals.\n\nTables:\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events`, `quests`, `quest_milestones` — campaign state, session log, and quest tracker.\n- `factions`, `npcs` — campaign factions and NPCs with relationship disposition.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled campaign sessions and per-character attendance.\n- `play_campaigns` — protected play-surface campaigns owned by a `dm` user.\n- `play_campaign_members` — player memberships in a play campaign, with one row per `(campaign_id, username)` and unique `character_id` per campaign.\n- `play_campaign_narrations` — append-only narration/action/resolution events for play campaigns.\n\n### Routing\n\n`Main` creates an `HttpServer` from `com.sun.net.httpserver`, builds a `RequestRouter`, and calls `router.register(server)` to attach all contexts.\n`RequestRouter` does not implement request logic itself; it instantiates domain handlers and wires contexts to handler methods.\n\nShared handler infrastructure lives in `BaseHandler`:\n- `requireMethod`, `badRequest`, `notFound`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`\n- exact JSON error-body constants\n- `authenticate` — validates `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>` and supports deterministic fixture tokens even after a storage reset.\n\nHandlers are grouped by domain and file:\n\n- **Core:** `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`, `/v1/characters/*`\n- **Combat:** `/v1/combat/sessions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance`\n- **Auth:** `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login`\n- **Storage:** `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset`\n- **Compendium:** `/v1/compendium/monsters`, `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`, `/v1/compendium/items`, `/v1/compendium/items/{slug}`\n- **Campaigns:** `/v1/campaigns`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/state`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/characters`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/events`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/factions`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/{project_id}/advance`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/next`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/{session_id}/attendance`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/export`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/audit`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/{quest_id}/progress`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/summary`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory/summary`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/characters/{character_id}/equipment`\n- **PHB rules:** `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load`\n- **DM tools:** `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap`\n- **Play campaigns:** `/v1/play/campaigns`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document`\n\nMost handlers validate the request body, throw `RuntimeException` on bad input, and translate any exception into a `400` response. Missing resources return `404`. Conflicts return `409`.\n\n### JSON handling\n\nRequests and responses are JSON. The built-in `JsonParser` and `JsonUtils` are intentionally minimal and preserve the exact output format expected by the test suite:\n\n- Field order is determined by `LinkedHashMap` insertion order.\n- Numbers without a fractional part are serialized as integers.\n- Only standard escape sequences are supported.\n\nIf you change serialization, ensure the test suite output format stays identical.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Initiative and combat\n\n- `POST /v1/initiative/order` — sorts combatants by `roll + dex`, breaking ties by dex then name.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions` — creates a persisted combat session with a sorted order and returns the first active combatant.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions` — adds a timed condition to a combatant in the session.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance` — advances the turn tracker, increments the round on wrap, and decrements/removes conditions on the newly active combatant.\n\n### Encounter math\n\n- `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp` — calculates base XP, multiplier, adjusted XP, and difficulty thresholds for a party.\n- `POST /v1/dm/encounter-builder` — looks up monster slugs Requires an `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>` header; only `dm` users may create. Returns the created campaign with `owner`, `status: \"lobby\"`, and `max_players`.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members` lets an authenticated player join a lobby campaign. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only `player` users may join. Body `{\"character_id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\",\"class\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with `username`, `character_id`, `name`, and `class`. A player may own at most one membership per campaign, character IDs must be unique within the campaign, and the party cannot exceed `max_players`; any of those conflicts returns 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start` starts a lobby campaign. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may start. A lobby campaign with at least two party members becomes `active` exactly once and returns `{\"id\":\"...\",\"status\":\"active\",\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"turn_number\":1}`, where `current_actor` is the alphabetically first party member. Returns 403 for non-owners or players, 404 if the campaign does not exist, and 409 if the campaign is already active or has fewer than two members.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn` reads the current turn. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner or a party member may read. Returns the campaign's `current_actor`, `phase` (`lobby`, `dm`, or `player`), `turn_number`, a deterministic `queue`, plus deterministic timeout metadata: `overdue` (`false` for a fresh turn) and a logical integer `logical_deadline`. For an active campaign, the queue is built by alternating each party member (in the deterministic party order) with the DM — for example, a two-player party yields `[\"player-a\",\"dm\",\"player-b\",\"dm\"]`. Lobby campaigns return an empty queue. The deadline is a logical integer derived from the turn number; wall-clock time is not used.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge` lets the campaign owner send a nonempty reminder message to the current actor. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may call it. Body `{\"message\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with `actor` (the owner), `target` (the campaign's `current_actor`), `message`, and a monotonically increasing `nudge_count`. Players and non-members receive 403; unauthenticated requests receive 401; an empty message returns 400.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/my-turn` returns the player-specific turn context for an authenticated party member with role `player`. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; returns 401 if unauthenticated, 403 for non-players or non-members, and 404 if the campaign does not exist. Returns `{\"is_my_turn\":bool,\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"character\":{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\"},\"recent_events\":[...]}`. The player only sees their own character (id and name) and the public play-campaign narration events; no DM-private fields are exposed.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status` returns the owner-only GM turn context. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may read. Players receive 403. Returns `{\"needs_attention\":bool,\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"party\":[...],\"recent_events\":[...]}`. `needs_attention` is `true` exactly when the current actor is the owner. `party` is a summary of all party members (`username`, `character_id`, `name`, `class`). `recent_events` are the public play-campaign narration events.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations` appends a DM narration event. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may narrate. Body `{\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"narration\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"...\"}`. Sequence starts at 1 for each campaign and is append-only. Players receive 403.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions` lets the active party player submit an action. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the player whose username matches the campaign's `current_actor` may submit. Body `{\"type\":\"...\",\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"action\",\"actor\":\"...\",\"type\":\"...\",\"text\":\"...\",\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}`, advances the campaign's `current_actor` to the DM, and increments the turn number. A waiting player or the DM receives 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/resolutions` lets the campaign owner resolve the current DM turn. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the owner may call it when `current_actor` is the owner. Body `{\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"...\",\"next_actor\":\"...\",\"turn_number\":1}`, advances the campaign's `current_actor` to the next party member in the deterministic queue, and returns the current turn number. A player attempting resolution receives 409.\n- `PUT /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` updates the durable, role-filtered campaign document. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner may update. Body `{\"story\":\"...\",\"dm_notes\":\"...\"}`. Returns 200 with both `story` and `dm_notes`.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` reads the campaign document. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; the owner receives both `story` and `dm_notes`, while a party player receives only `story`. Non-members and players attempting to update receive 403.\n\n### Auth\n\n- `POST /v1/auth/register` — validates username, password length, and role (`dm` or `player`), then stores a PBKDF2 hash.\n- `POST /v1/auth/login` — verifies the password and returns a deterministic `session-{username}` token.\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n1. **Keep handlers stateless.** Handler classes extend `BaseHandler` and hold only a `Storage` reference; methods read the request, call storage, and write a response. No mutable state should live in handlers.\n2. **Use `LinkedHashMap` for deterministic JSON output.** The test suite compares exact JSON strings in many places, so shared error response bodies are kept as exact string constants in `BaseHandler`.\n3. **Preserve the JSON number format.** `JsonUtils.toJson` emits integers for whole numbers and doubles otherwise.\n4. **Validate with `RuntimeException`.** Handlers catch generic exceptions and map them to `400`. Use explicit validation messages for debugging, but never leak them in the HTTP body.\n5. **Use the storage lock for concurrency.** `Storage` serializes all database access. Do not add secondary caches that bypass the lock.\n6. **Test via run.sh.** Always compile and start the server through `./run.sh` before running evaluators.
